inferences: Change documentation, pricing and approval questions are original practical guidance, not attributed as verified competitor policies.
claimBoundaries: Public competitor pages identify content patterns, not ranking causation.
No owner biography, founding date, team size, certification, insurance, rating, testimonial, project-count or warranty promise is added.
Any project-specific written warranty terms are items to clarify in an agreement, not a blanket Tiling.ca warranty.
Keep existing direct-contractor positioning, contact details and Formspree endpoint.
Local pages describe service areas rather than offices.
Photographs and plans are sent by email after enquiry; no file-upload capability is claimed.
Pricing references remain third-party planning benchmarks, not business rates.
implementation: Shared company-data.ts and company-content.tsx, localized routes/metadata, matching visible FAQ schema, one existing QuoteForm per page, current sitemap dates and links to services, materials, location pages and pricing guides.
